entries.text: Eighteen ranked results-corpus bundles that recorded wrong values from SQL translations since superseded by the SQLGlot fork (ClickHouse Local TPC-H and TPC-DS, DataFusion TPC-DI, TPC-DS and CoffeeShop, SQLite CoffeeShop) carry the new `defective-superseded-sql-translation` known-defect id in their submission manifests and drop out of rankings as `known_defective_data`; the id is accepted by submission validation. The TPC-DI SF0.01 and CoffeeShop SF0.01 cohorts are listed as documented shallow cohorts until the cells are rerun. `results-data/CORPUS_NOTES.md` records the cause and PRs per group, the bundles that changed only in timing or text, and other issues found (SQLite ClickBench SF1 row counts, `DESC NULLS LAST` on Snowflake and Databricks).
